{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Fix revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Drop QA orders and refunded orders
filtered_df = df[(df['revenue'] != 999999.99) & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Compute conversion rate by channel within each segment
segmented_conversions = filtered_df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].agg(['count', 'sum']).reset_index()
segmented_conversions.columns = ['channel', 'customer_segment', 'total', 'converted']

# Compute conversion rate per segment
segmented_conversions['conversion_rate'] = segmented_conversions['converted'] / segmented_conversions['total']

# Compute segment-specific differences (email - paid_search)
differences = []
for segment in segmented_conversions['customer_segment'].unique():
    email_rate = segmented_conversions.loc[
        (segmented_conversions['channel'] == 'email') & (segmented_conversions['customer_segment'] == segment),
        'conversion_rate'
    ].values[0]
    paid_search_rate = segmented_conversions.loc[
        (segmented_conversions['channel'] == 'paid_search') & (segmented_conversions['customer_segment'] == segment),
        'conversion_rate'
    ].values[0]
    diff = email_rate - paid_search_rate
    differences.append(diff)
    print(f"Segment {segment}: email - paid_search = {diff:.5f}")

# Compute total orders per segment
segment_totals = filtered_df.groupby('customer_segment')['channel'].count().reset_index()
segment_totals.columns = ['customer_segment', 'total_in_segment']

# Compute weighted average of differences
weighted_diff = (sum(d * total for d, total in zip(differences, segment_totals['total_in_segment'])) / 
                 segment_totals['total_in_segment'].sum())

print(f"\nWeighted average difference (email - paid_search) in conversion rates: {weighted_diff}")"}
